_note: Community-submitted, UNTESTED factory images for the badge. Each is served same-origin from community/firmware/ and flashed at 0x0. These are NOT hardware-verified by Retia — the site warns and gates every flash. Added by pull request; a maintainer validates with the catbadge-community-image skill. Schema per image: { id, name, author, source, desc, file, url, addr, sha256, submitted }.

images.name: Pusheen Danza
images.author: skickar
images.desc: A dancing Pusheen fills the screen while the Danza Kuduro horn hook plays on the piezo (transcribed from audio); a rainbow wave flows across the ear NeoPixels and the SAO LED flashes on the beat. Press A to mute. Display/LED/audio only — no radio, no TX. No SD card needed.
